title: Adding a note is gated by the record's View permission
custom_preconds:
1. You are signed in as a user, on the build under test. The Notifications Center feature is on.
  2. Sign in as (a) a user without "Work Orders -> View", and (b) a user with only "Part Sales -> View".
custom_steps:
1. As the user without "Work Orders -> View", try to add a note to a work order or work order line.
  2. As the user with only "Part Sales -> View", try to add a note to a Part Sale.
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Adding a note to a work order or work order line requires "Work Orders -> View".
  • Adding a note to a Part Sale requires "Work Orders -> View" or "Part Sales -> View".

Source - where this behaviour comes from
Epic SV-9667; story SV-10253 (S10, Permissions); Notifications Update v1 PRD (Confluence 817463297), S10; read 30 Sep 2026. Source-verified 30 September 2026; not yet build-verified.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

  • S10-R3: “Adding a note to a work order or work order line requires 'Work Orders -> View'.”
  • S10-R4: “Adding a note to a Part Sale requires 'Work Orders -> View' or 'Part Sales -> View'.”
